newsitem.title: ITALY: Burglars steal Italian director Antonioni's Oscar.
newsitem.headline: Burglars steal Italian director Antonioni's Oscar.

text.p: Burglars stole an Oscar and other awards belonging to Italian film director Michelangleo Antonioni during Christmas, newspapers reported on Saturday.
"I would like to make an appeal to the thieves: give back to Michelangelo the history of his life," the director's wife Enrica Fico was quoted as telling the daily La Repubblica.

The newspaper said burglars had broken into 84-year-old Antonioni's Rome apartment while he was away during Christmas, stealing the Oscar he was awarded in 1995 for his career achievement as well as prizes won at the Cannes and Venice film festivals.
Antonioni, perhaps best known for his 1967 film "Blow Up", was on holiday in Venice at the time of the burglary.

Antonioni returned to work after 14 years last year when he co-directed "Beyond the Clouds" with German Wim Wenders. The film was presented in a special non-competition slot at the 1995 Venice film festival.
